sam (arch): FYI -- during yesterday's canary we saw oscillation when we hot-swapped model versions. proposal: a small rollout token in alias metadata to enable hedged transitions and a deterministic pin precedence matrix.
anya (runtime): sketch the token and behavior?
sam (arch): metadata fields: rollout_token, hedging_ms, pin_policy (enum: tenant_first, admin_first, force_admin), serve_overlap_ms. Example: { rollout_token: 'rt-20260510-7', hedging_ms: 30000, serve_overlap_ms: 120000, pin_policy: 'tenant_first' }. Hedging_ms tells runtime to accept short dual-writes and prefer warmed variants.
leo (infra): how does this interact with existing tenant pins and model locks?
marta (product): customers expect pins to be honored. we should make tenant pins highest precedence, but admins need a force option for emergencies.
kevin (sre): telemetry hooks: rollout_token_events, hedged_misses, pin_policy_overrides. alert if hedged_misses spike.
anya (runtime): runtime plan: introduce a hot-swap lease token tied to rollout_token. When alias flips, previous binding enters HEDGED state for serve_overlap_ms; runtime serves both variants deterministically using tenant pin_policy. After serve_overlap_ms and low traffic, drop old binding. Tenant explicit pins short-circuit hedging.
sam (arch): backwards compat: unknown fields are ignored. default pin_policy=tenant_first and hedging disabled. gate hedging behind cluster FF.
leo (infra): migration: enable FF in staging, run churn test (flip storm) and verify cold-start reduction and no increased error-rate.
kevin (sre): also add trace tag 'rollout.token' and span annotation when hedged-serving occurs so we can correlate errors.
ci-bot: created TICKET-2026-771: "rollout_token hedging + pin precedence telemetry" assigned to anya.
sam (arch): decision: prototype rollout_token + hedging behind FF in staging. owners: anya(runtime impl), leo(infra rollout), marta(product messaging), kevin(sre telemetry). i'll draft RFC for a pin precedence matrix and token lifecycle.
